Problem Statement:
You are given an array A of N integers. Each integer A[ i ] (1 <= i <= N) is an integer between 1 and N both inclusive. You can replace A[ i ] with any integer from 1 to N both inclusive. Find the minimum number of elements to be replaced so that the resulting array is a valid permutation of the array B = [1, 2, ..., N]. 
Input Description:
The first line contains the number of integers N.
The second line contains N space separated integers. 
Output Description:
Print a single line containing an integer denoting the minimum number of replacements. 
Explanation:
3 is replaced by 5 
Sample Input:
5
3 4 3 1 2 
Sample Output:
1
